detailed_descriptions.en: You dropped your favorite needle... in a barn with exactly One Billion pieces of hay. Guess you better go find the needle in a haystack. Search around with your hands, find coins to purchase tools and search faster, and eventually reclaim your lost needle. One Billion Hay! Have you ever wanted to find a needle in a haystack? How about in a billion hay? Search through exactly one billion pieces of hay, starting with just your hands. Destroy Hay and Find Coins! Destroy hay and find buried coins! Upgrade Your Tools! Use those coins to buy upgrades and tools to search through the hay faster and find the needle! Needle in a haystack! Eventually find the needle in a haystack. Tough, but (probably) not impossible.
